info.name: Nextcloud MCP Server
info.summary: Exposes Nextcloud capabilities as MCP tools
info.description:
Nextcloud MCP Server provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface to Nextcloud. This allows any MCP-compatible client to access Nextcloud tools and resources.
Features: - Exposes Nextcloud capabilities (mail, calendar, files, etc.) as MCP tools - No LLM required - pure tool gateway - Can be used by any MCP client (AI agents, CLI tools, scripts) - Authentication via Nextcloud user context
This app is a standalone MCP server with no AI dependencies.
info.author: Marcel Klehr
